text.3:102: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah with right observance, and die not save as those who have surrendered (unto Him)
text.19:13: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout,
text.19:18: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.
text.19:63: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.
